name: Reversewordcipher

description_json.name: ReverseWordCipher
description_json.idea: Each individual word in the text is reversed characters-wise, while maintaining the original position of capitalization (the casing of the letters remains at the same index positions as the original word). Non-alphabetic characters (punctuation, spaces, digits) remain in their original positions and are not reversed.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Split the text into words (sequences of alphabetic characters) and non-words (spaces, punctuation, digits).
2. For each alphabetic word:
   a. Record the capitalization pattern (which indices are uppercase and lowercase).
   b. Reverse the sequence of letters in the word, ignoring case during reversal.
   c. Apply the recorded capitalization pattern to the reversed letters (e.g., if the 1st letter of the original word was uppercase, the 1st letter of the reversed word becomes uppercase).
3. Reassemble the text with the non-word characters in their original positions.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Split the text into words (sequences of alphabetic characters) and non-words (spaces, punctuation, digits).
2. For each alphabetic word:
   a. Record the capitalization pattern (which indices are uppercase and lowercase).
   b. Reverse the sequence of letters in the word, ignoring case during reversal.
   c. Apply the recorded capitalization pattern to the reversed letters.
3. Reassemble the text with the non-word characters in their original positions. (Since reversal is its own inverse, decryption uses the exact same algorithm as encryption).
